headline: Midwestern State stays unbeaten against Cal State San Bernardino
dek: Midwestern State drew with Cal State San Bernardino at home, a side that beat Texas A&M International in September. The draw leaves Midwestern State with sixteen wins and six draws without a loss, having scored 57 goals and conceded eighteen.
displaced_by: Midwestern State drew with Cal State San Bernardino, making the previous dek's five-draw figure stale

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Fourteen different players have scored Midwestern State's 57 goals, and Parker Plaxco has nineteen of them.

wire.line: Every side but Midwestern State has now lost at least once.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches are past their date with no result published: Lubbock Christian's against Western Texas, Southwest and Hardin-Simmons, St. Edward's against Southwestern, and Oklahoma Christian's against Oklahoma Panhandle State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Oklahoma Christian has lost four times, with St. Mary's the only conference side to beat it.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UT Dallas has lost twice, against eleven wins and seven draws, and conceded sixteen goals.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Sul Ross State has lost all sixteen of its matches and scored twice.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fernando Hernandez has made 78 saves for Sul Ross State.

last_match.line: Midwestern State remains unbeaten on the season; Cal State San Bernardino had beaten Texas A&M International in its only previous match against the conference.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
